newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil cuts Canada crude prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil cuts Canada crude prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$9.00/cubic metre or C$1.43/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$171.00/cubic metre, or C$27.19/barrel Cromer light sour C$164.00/cubic metre, or C$26.07/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$131.00/cubic metre, or C$20.83/barrel Midale at Cromer C$139.00/cubic metre, or C$22.09/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
